CustomField.description: How the Revenue Cloud pricing procedure prices quotes on this price book. Per Module: each quote line is priced at the tier for its own Number of Users, with the multi-module discount. Module Count: the highest Number of Users on any line sets one band for the whole quote, and the number of modules sets the quote total.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Per Module: each module is priced from its own users. Module Count: the highest users on any module and the number of modules set the quote total.
CustomField.label: Pricing Method
